name: Tidegate — twin bascule bridge
source: function(t,s,m,r){function cl(v,a){return Math.max(-a,Math.min(a,v));}function profile(t){var u=((t%22)+22)%22;if(u<2)return [0,0];if(u<5){var a=(u-2)/3;return [0.58*(3*a*a-2*a*a*a),0.58*6*a*(1-a)/3];}if(u<11)return [0.58,0];if(u<16){var a=(u-11)/5;return [0.58*(1-3*a*a+2*a*a*a),-0.58*6*a*(1-a)/5];}return [0,0];}var out={};function servo(i,p,sign,neg,pos){var u=cl((sign*p[1]+2.4*(sign*p[0]-s.angles[i])-0.15*s.rates[i])/0.5,1);out[u>=0?pos:neg]=Math.abs(u);}servo(28,profile(t),1,'Q','A');servo(40,profile(Math.max(0,t-0.6)),-1,'W','S');return out;}

name: Gyro garden flyer
source: function(t,s,m,r){function cl(v,a){return Math.max(-a,Math.min(a,v));}if(m.x===undefined){m.x=s.x;m.z=s.z;m.hi=0;}var a=0.22*Math.max(0,t-2),run=t>2?1:0;var tx=m.x+3*Math.sin(a),tz=m.z+3*(Math.cos(a)-1),tvx=run*0.66*Math.cos(a),tvz=-run*0.66*Math.sin(a);var ax=cl(0.45*(tx-s.x)+1.3*(tvx-s.vx)-run*0.1452*Math.sin(a),0.9),az=cl(0.45*(tz-s.z)+1.3*(tvz-s.vz)-run*0.1452*Math.cos(a),0.9);var q=s.rotation,x=q[0],y=q[1],z=q[2],w=q[3];var lx=(1-2*(y*y+z*z))*ax+2*(x*z-y*w)*az,lz=2*(x*z+y*w)*ax+(1-2*(x*x+y*y))*az;var g=s.gravity,gy=s.gyroscope,G=Math.sqrt(g[0]*g[0]+g[1]*g[1]+g[2]*g[2]);var pitch=Math.atan2(g[2],-g[1]),roll=Math.atan2(-g[0],-g[1]);var pd=cl(lz/G,0.24),rd=cl(-lx/G,0.24);var mx=20*(pd-pitch)-8*gy[0],mz=20*(rd-roll)-8*gy[2];var hy=3+0.4*Math.sin(0.3*t),eh=hy-s.y;m.hi=cl(m.hi+eh*s.dt,2);var ay=cl(3*eh-3*s.vy+0.3*m.hi,4);var base=s.mass*(G+ay)/(4*Math.max(0.6,s.up));function jet(f){return Math.max(0,Math.min(1,f/20));}return {A:jet(base-mz/2),S:jet(base+mz/2),D:jet(base-mx/2),F:jet(base+mx/2)};}

name: Lopsided lantern flyer
source: function(t,s,m,r){function cl(v,a){return Math.max(-a,Math.min(a,v));}if(m.x===undefined){m.x=s.x;m.z=s.z;m.hi=0;m.pi=0;m.ri=0;}var a=0.17*Math.max(0,t-2),run=t>2?1:0;var ax=cl(0.32*(m.x+4*Math.sin(a)-s.x)+1.2*(run*0.68*Math.cos(a)-s.vx)-run*0.1156*Math.sin(a),0.8),az=cl(0.32*(m.z+2*Math.sin(2*a)-s.z)+1.2*(run*0.68*Math.cos(2*a)-s.vz)-run*0.2312*Math.sin(2*a),0.8);var q=s.rotation,x=q[0],y=q[1],z=q[2],w=q[3];function local(v){return [(1-2*(y*y+z*z))*v[0]+2*(x*y+z*w)*v[1]+2*(x*z-y*w)*v[2],2*(x*y-z*w)*v[0]+(1-2*(x*x+z*z))*v[1]+2*(y*z+x*w)*v[2],2*(x*z+y*w)*v[0]+2*(y*z-x*w)*v[1]+(1-2*(x*x+y*y))*v[2]];}var acc=local([ax,0,az]),com=local([s.centerOfMass[0]-s.x,s.centerOfMass[1]-s.y,s.centerOfMass[2]-s.z]);var g=s.gravity,gy=s.gyroscope,G=Math.sqrt(g[0]*g[0]+g[1]*g[1]+g[2]*g[2]);var ep=cl(acc[2]/G,0.22)-Math.atan2(g[2],-g[1]),er=cl(-acc[0]/G,0.22)-Math.atan2(-g[0],-g[1]);m.pi=cl(m.pi+ep*s.dt,0.4);m.ri=cl(m.ri+er*s.dt,0.4);var eh=5+0.6*Math.sin(0.2*t)-s.y;m.hi=cl(m.hi+eh*s.dt,2);var ay=cl(3*eh-3*s.vy+0.3*m.hi,4),total=s.mass*(G+ay)/Math.max(0.6,s.up),base=total/4;var mx=32*ep-14*gy[0]+2*m.pi-total*com[2],mz=32*er-14*gy[2]+2*m.ri+total*com[0];function jet(f){return Math.max(0,Math.min(1,f/30));}return {A:jet(base-mz/2),S:jet(base+mz/2),D:jet(base-mx/2),F:jet(base+mx/2)};}

name: Channel catamaran — feedback patrol
source: function(t,s,m,r){function cl(v,a){return Math.max(-a,Math.min(a,v));}function wrap(v){return Math.atan2(Math.sin(v),Math.cos(v));}if(m.x===undefined){m.x=s.x;m.z=s.z;m.k=0;m.i=0;m.stuck=0;m.back=0;}if(t<1.5)return {};if(t<m.back)return {Q:0.4,W:0.4};var contact=false;for(var j=0;j<s.touching.length;j++)if(s.touching[j])contact=true;var speed=Math.sqrt(s.vx*s.vx+s.vz*s.vz);m.stuck=contact&&speed<0.2?m.stuck+s.dt:0;if(m.stuck>0.8){m.back=t+1.8;m.k=(m.k+1)%4;m.stuck=0;m.i=0;return {Q:0.4,W:0.4};}var points=[[0,5],[4,5],[4,-5],[0,-5]],p=points[m.k];var dx=m.x+p[0]-s.x,dz=m.z+p[1]-s.z,d=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dz*dz);if(d<1.2){m.k=(m.k+1)%4;m.i=0;p=points[m.k];dx=m.x+p[0]-s.x;dz=m.z+p[1]-s.z;d=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dz*dz);}var q=s.rotation,yaw=Math.atan2(2*(q[0]*q[2]+q[1]*q[3]),1-2*(q[0]*q[0]+q[1]*q[1]));var e=wrap(Math.atan2(dx,dz)-yaw),v=s.localVelocity[2],want=Math.min(1.5,0.65*d)*Math.max(0,Math.cos(e));if(Math.abs(e)>1.1)want=0;var ev=want-v;m.i=cl(m.i+ev*s.dt,2);var drive=cl(0.24*want+0.35*ev+0.05*m.i,0.62),turn=cl(0.85*e-0.95*s.gyroscope[1],0.7);if(s.up<0.85)drive=0;var l=cl(drive+turn,1),rr=cl(drive-turn,1),out={};out[l>=0?'A':'Q']=Math.abs(l);out[rr>=0?'S':'W']=Math.abs(rr);return out;}

name: Harbor Atlas — slew, luff and hoist
source: function(t,s,m,r){function cl(v,a){return Math.max(-a,Math.min(a,v));}var out={};function servo(i,goal,feed,speed,neg,pos){var u=cl((feed+2.2*(goal-s.angles[i])-0.18*s.rates[i])/speed,1);out[u>=0?pos:neg]=Math.abs(u);}servo(13,0.62*Math.sin(0.23*t),0.1426*Math.cos(0.23*t),0.5,'Q','A');servo(14,0.22+0.1*Math.sin(0.31*t),0.031*Math.cos(0.31*t),0.5,'W','S');var travel=1.35*(1-Math.cos(0.36*t));if(s.touching[22])travel=Math.max(0,s.angles[20]-0.3);servo(20,travel,0.486*Math.sin(0.36*t),0.75,'E','D');return out;}

name: Skybarge — damped cargo flight
source: function(t,s,m,r){function cl(v,a){return Math.max(-a,Math.min(a,v));}if(m.x===undefined){m.x=s.x;m.z=s.z;m.hi=0;m.pi=0;m.ri=0;}var a=0.13*Math.max(0,t-3),run=t>3?1:0;var ax=cl(0.28*(m.x+5*Math.sin(a)-s.x)+1.1*(run*0.65*Math.cos(a)-s.vx)-run*0.0845*Math.sin(a),0.7),az=cl(0.28*(m.z+3*Math.sin(2*a)-s.z)+1.1*(run*0.78*Math.cos(2*a)-s.vz)-run*0.2028*Math.sin(2*a),0.7);var q=s.rotation,x=q[0],y=q[1],z=q[2],w=q[3];function local(v){return [(1-2*(y*y+z*z))*v[0]+2*(x*y+z*w)*v[1]+2*(x*z-y*w)*v[2],2*(x*y-z*w)*v[0]+(1-2*(x*x+z*z))*v[1]+2*(y*z+x*w)*v[2],2*(x*z+y*w)*v[0]+2*(y*z-x*w)*v[1]+(1-2*(x*x+y*y))*v[2]];}var acc=local([ax,0,az]),com=local([s.centerOfMass[0]-s.x,s.centerOfMass[1]-s.y,s.centerOfMass[2]-s.z]),g=s.gravity,gy=s.gyroscope,G=Math.sqrt(g[0]*g[0]+g[1]*g[1]+g[2]*g[2]);var ep=cl(acc[2]/G,0.18)-Math.atan2(g[2],-g[1]),er=cl(-acc[0]/G,0.18)-Math.atan2(-g[0],-g[1]);m.pi=cl(m.pi+ep*s.dt,0.4);m.ri=cl(m.ri+er*s.dt,0.4);var eh=s.ground+6+0.5*Math.sin(0.16*t)-s.y;m.hi=cl(m.hi+eh*s.dt,2);var ay=cl(3*eh-3*s.vy+0.3*m.hi,4),total=s.mass*(G+ay)/Math.max(0.65,s.up),base=total/4,mx=140*ep-85*gy[0]+4*m.pi-total*com[2],mz=140*er-85*gy[2]+4*m.ri+total*com[0];function jet(f){return Math.max(0,Math.min(1,f/35));}return {A:jet(base-mx/8-mz/8),S:jet(base-mx/8+mz/8),D:jet(base+mx/8-mz/8),F:jet(base+mx/8+mz/8)};}
